item.title: Re: Christmas SCPs
item.content:encoded:
SCP-239 apparently created some kind of Santa-like anomaly, though idk if it would continue to exist now that she's in a coma.

If you're interested in Tales, there's a strange number of them featuring Dr. Clef, such as:

  • How Dr. Clef Contained Christmas!
  • How Dr. Clef Saved Christmas
  • How Dr. Clef Got Into My Santa Claus Pants I'll Never Know
  • A Keter Kinda Christmas
  • A Site-19 Christmas Carol is pretty good too, but it's very long.

item.title: Christmas SCPs
item.content:encoded:
Hi. I'm looking to do readings (https://www.youtube.com/c/ReadOut) of Christmas SCP items. These are the one's I've got:

784 - Christmas Cheer
1225 - The Worst Christmas
1933 - Bailey's Santa
2497 - Home for the CactusNights
2536 - The Gift That Keeps On Giving
3193 - Christmas War
3355 - St. Nick
4255 - Santa Claus, The Time Traveler
4666 - Yule Man

So, are there any (including deleted ones) that I've missed?
